title: S35 — Multi-scale template matching: handle size variation in corroded glyphs
desc: Corrosion erosion changes glyph size. Current templates are single-scale. Method: (1) implement multi-scale matching (±10%, ±20% scale variations); (2) test on corrosion-family images; (3) measure match rate improvement; (4) profile latency impact (must stay under 10s bar); (5) if improvement > 5% and latency OK, wire in. Owner: cormac. Priority: 3. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
